scientific_question: Does train-fold local-chemistry ranking improve all six measured-Ugi role-distribution distances over the otherwise matched complete-semantic MOG decoder at the completed 256-program preflight scale?
nonclaims: This is a seed-0 train-fold-only diagnostic over an already completed 256-program preflight, not a full-budget or across-training-seed model claim.
The reassessment performs no training, generation, repair, retry, routing, oracle calls or candidate selection.
The local-chemistry score uses aggregate train-fold context frequencies and no component identities or stored component graphs.
The panel reports directional consistency without a confidence interval or significance claim.
C2ST is secondary and does not determine the panel classification.
A favorable role panel cannot override validity, exact-L1, unique-yield, effective-count or blinded visual gates.
